student.description: The student the report belongs to, from the header

name.description: The student's name as printed after 'Name:'

grade.description: The student's grade level at the time of the test, as a number

record_locator.description: The College Board record locator, the digits after 'Record Locator:'

test.description: Which SAT administration the scores are from

administration.description: The test administration as printed, e.g. 'SAT June 7, 2025'

test_date.description: The date the student tested, from 'Tested on:', as printed

score.description: The total score, on the 400-1600 scale

percentile.description: The percentile shown beside the total score, as a number without the ordinal suffix, e.g. 96

score_range.description: The total score range as printed, e.g. '1430-1510'

average_score.description: The 3 year average total score for all testers

section_scores.description: One entry per section score, in the order printed

section.description: The section name, e.g. 'Reading and Writing' or 'Math'

score.description: The section score, on the 200-800 scale

percentile.description: The percentile shown beside the section score, as a number without the ordinal suffix

score_range.description: The section score range as printed, e.g. '650-710'

average_score.description: The 3 year average section score for all testers

knowledge_and_skills.description: One entry per content domain in the Knowledge and Skills panel, in the order printed

section.description: The section the domain belongs to, 'Reading and Writing' or 'Math'

share_of_section_percent.description: The domain's share of its test section, as a number, e.g. 35

question_count.description: The number of questions in the domain as printed, e.g. '13-15'

performance_band.description: The performance score band as printed after 'Performance:', e.g. '680-800'
